overview: 今日专题“全球经济与金融”。共筛选 21 个高价值事件，重点关注中国相关进展、美国相关进展及全球外交、经济与安全动态。

items.title: Why new US tariffs threaten Trump government’s credibility in Asean
items.summary: A new wave of US tariffs that hit seven Southeast Asian countries is set to reinforce perceptions of Washington as an unreliable partner to the region, according to analysts. Citing what it said were forced labour practices uncovered in its latest investigations, the US on Thursday imposed levies ranging from 10 to 12.5 per cent on 60 economies – with the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam the hardest hit among Association of Southeast Asian Nations members. Malaysia, Indonesia and...
items.titleZh: 为何美国新关税威胁特朗普政府在东盟的信誉
items.summaryZh: 美国以所谓“强迫劳动”为由，对包括菲律宾、新加坡、泰国和越南在内的七个东南亚国家征收10%至12.5%的关税。分析人士认为，此举将损害美国作为东盟可靠合作伙伴的形象。
items.whyImportant: 美国贸易保护主义政策可能导致其在东南亚的战略影响力受损。

items.title: Treasure as trinkets: Zendaya’s earrings renew debate on ownership of ancient artefacts
items.summary: Jewellery made from BC Iran worn at Odyssey photocall throws spotlight on the trade of rare archeological finds The Odyssey has stormed cinemas, but while its take on the Homeric epic has created ripples among western classicists, it is an actor’s earrings that have made waves further afield. Zendaya, who portrays the goddess Athena in the movie, provoked outrage when she appeared at a London photocall wearing earrings that were allegedly made from Iranian artefacts dating back to the 1st millennium BC. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 珍宝变饰品：赞达亚佩戴的耳环引发关于古代文物所有权的争议
items.summaryZh: 演员赞达亚在电影宣传活动中佩戴了一对据称由公元前1世纪伊朗文物制成的耳环，引发了公众对古代文物贸易和所有权的广泛讨论。此举在文化遗产保护界引起了强烈反响。
items.whyImportant: 该事件引发了关于名人时尚选择与古代文物道德归属之间的舆论争议。

items.title: Syria’s US$216 billion rebuild offers a Hormuz alternative
items.summary: For years, Syria was a wound the world watched fester: a country carved up by war, sanctioned into isolation and reduced to a byword for state collapse. Its economy needs US$216 billion to rebuild, according to World Bank estimates. This month, for the first time since the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, it began to look like it might actually get there. On July 8, the government of Ahmed al-Sharaa – a former jihadi commander turned president – established a supreme constitutional...
items.titleZh: 叙利亚2160亿美元的重建计划提供了一条霍尔木兹海峡之外的替代路径
items.summaryZh: 在经历多年战乱与制裁后，叙利亚政府正寻求2160亿美元的重建资金。随着新政府成立，该国开始探索经济复苏及地缘政治中的新角色。
items.whyImportant: 叙利亚的重建进程可能改变中东地区的地缘经济格局。

items.title: Albanese at odds with Labor policy which now says telehealth should be allowed for euthanasia consultations
items.summary: Campaigners say existing federal ban on phone or video calls for assisted dying consultations adversely affects people living in regional Australia Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Labor will come under pressure to allow Australians to access voluntary assisted dying through telehealth services, with the Greens and independent Kate Chaney to introduce legislation based on changes to Labor’s national platform. Last week’s national conference in Adelaide changed the ALP platform and committed Labor to overturn a Howard-era law banning people from having medical appointments regarding euthanasia via telehealth services. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 阿尔巴尼斯与工党政策产生分歧，该政策现主张允许通过远程医疗进行安乐死咨询
items.summaryZh: 工党全国会议修改了党纲，承诺推翻霍华德时代禁止通过远程医疗进行安乐死咨询的法律。活动人士指出，现行禁令对偏远地区的澳大利亚人造成了不利影响，绿党和独立议员正推动相关立法。
items.whyImportant: 此举反映了澳大利亚在安乐死医疗服务获取公平性方面的政策转向与内部政治博弈。

items.title: Family of missing Rohingya footballer fear he is among 500 believed dead in Myanmar shipwrecks
items.summary: ‘I can’t tolerate this life,’ said the 24-year-old in his last voice message to his relatives. Attacked by the military, a rebel army and criminal gangs, Siraz Ullah risked all for a better future The fear was audible as he spoke, recording a message to his family, asking for their prayers. After pressing send, 24-year-old Siraz Ullah boarded a boat he hoped could deliver him from the violence and persecution surrounding him at home in Myanmar. Instead, Siraz is among 500 Rohingya refugees who have vanished at sea after setting sail for Malaysia in late June. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 失踪罗兴亚足球运动员的家人担心他已在缅甸海难中遇难，该事故恐致500人死亡
items.summaryZh: 24岁的罗兴亚难民西拉兹·乌拉在逃离缅甸暴力迫害的途中失踪，据信他与另外500名难民在前往马来西亚的途中于海上失踪。他在最后发给家人的语音信息中表达了对生存环境的绝望。
items.whyImportant: 该事件凸显了罗兴亚难民在逃离迫害过程中面临的极端生存风险与人道主义危机。

items.title: French wildfires trigger mass evacuations around Bordeaux
items.summary: Around 200,000 people have been evacuated around Bordeaux as wildfires tear through southwestern France.
items.titleZh: 法国野火引发波尔多周边地区大规模疏散
items.summaryZh: 法国西南部地区遭遇严重野火侵袭，火势迅速蔓延。目前，波尔多周边已有约20万人被迫撤离家园。
items.whyImportant: 大规模的野火灾害对当地居民安全及生态环境造成了严重威胁。

items.title: At least 35 killed after two buses collide in eastern Syria
items.summary: The crash on a route notorious for deadly accidents prompted a large-scale rescue operation.
items.titleZh: 叙利亚东部两辆巴士相撞，造成至少35人死亡
items.summaryZh: 叙利亚一条以事故频发著称的公路上发生严重巴士相撞事故。当局已启动大规模救援行动以应对此次惨剧。
items.whyImportant: 此次重大交通事故再次暴露了当地交通基础设施的安全隐患。

items.title: ‘Defanging’ Aung San: Myanmar’s generals wage war on memory
items.summary: Across Myanmar, the statues are vanishing one by one. Military-backed authorities blame “incorrect proportions and shapes”. Unofficially, analysts see a deliberate attempt to erase the presence of independence hero Aung San from public life – and with it, the legitimacy of the elected government the junta overthrew. Revered as the country’s founding father, Aung San founded its military, united its diverse ethnic groups and spearheaded the nationalist movement that ultimately wrested...
items.titleZh: “去昂山化”：缅甸军方对历史记忆发动战争
items.summaryZh: 缅甸各地有关独立英雄昂山的雕像正逐渐消失，官方理由是比例不当，但分析人士认为这是军方试图抹除昂山在公众生活中的影响力。此举旨在削弱被推翻民选政府的合法性。
items.whyImportant: 通过重塑历史记忆，缅甸军方试图巩固其统治地位并消除前政权的政治遗产。

items.title: 布林肯 ： 若与中国一对一 ， 局面会十分艰难
items.titleZh: 布林肯：若与中国一对一，局面会十分艰难
items.summaryZh: 布林肯在相关表态中指出，在特定竞争环境下，若与中国进行直接的单边对抗，形势将面临巨大挑战。
items.whyImportant: 此言论反映了美国外交政策中对中美竞争复杂性的评估。

items.title: Yemen’s Houthis target Saudi oil facilities along the Red Sea
items.summary: Yemen's Houthis say they have targeted oil facilities in Saudi Arabia owned by Aramco.
items.titleZh: 也门胡塞武装袭击沙特红海沿岸石油设施
items.summaryZh: 也门胡塞武装宣称对沙特阿美公司位于红海沿岸的石油设施发动了袭击。目前尚无关于损失的详细报告。
items.whyImportant: 此类袭击加剧了中东地区的能源安全风险与地缘紧张局势。

items.title: T8 signal to be lowered to T3 at 12.40pm on Sunday as Typhoon Noul departs
items.summary: About 350 flights have been cancelled in Hong Kong on Sunday but most will resume in the afternoon, according to the Airport Authority, while the Observatory has said it will lower the No 8 storm signal to No 3 at 12.40pm as Typhoon Noul moves further away from the city. Apart from the 350 flights, more than 190 cross-border high-speed rail services have also been cancelled on Sunday. “Noul is moving steadily into inland Guangdong, starting to depart Hong Kong while weakening progressively....
items.titleZh: 台风“努尔”逐渐远离，香港将于周日中午12时40分改发三号强风信号
items.summaryZh: 随着台风“努尔”向广东内陆移动并逐渐减弱，香港天文台宣布将下调风球信号。受台风影响，周日约350个航班及190多班跨境高铁服务被迫取消。
items.whyImportant: 台风过境对香港的交通运输及社会运行造成了显著干扰。

items.title: Rare medical condition causes Chinese man’s scalp to thicken and fold, resembling human brain
items.summary: A man from central China had long been troubled by a thickening scalp that developed folds resembling the creases of a brain, but he eventually found a plastic surgeon who could address his condition. The 23-year-old man from Hunan province, surnamed Li, recently had his issue resolved at the Zhongnan Hospital of Wuhan University in Hubei. Li first noticed the hardening of his scalp several years ago. As the condition advanced, his scalp thickened and proliferated, creating large areas of uneven...
items.titleZh: 罕见疾病导致中国男子头皮增厚折叠，形似人脑
items.summaryZh: 一名23岁的中国男子因患有罕见头皮疾病，导致头皮增厚并出现类似大脑褶皱的纹路。近日，他在武汉大学中南医院通过整形手术成功解决了这一困扰多年的问题。
items.whyImportant: 该病例展示了现代医学在处理罕见皮肤病变方面的临床进展。

items.title: How Chinese scientists created an alloy that can survive 2,400 degrees Celsius
items.summary: A team of Chinese scientists says it has developed an alloy that retains strength at ultra-high temperatures using tantalum – a very hard and flexible metal. For applications in aerospace, hypersonic vehicles and nuclear reactors, materials must endure both extreme heat and heavy loads. But most metals fail above 2,000 degrees Celsius (3,632 degrees Fahrenheit) – they either melt or soften to a putty-like consistency. New research is challenging that limit. According to a paper published last...
items.titleZh: 中国科学家如何创造出能在2400摄氏度下保持强度的合金
items.summaryZh: 中国研究团队利用钽金属开发出一种新型合金，能够在超高温环境下保持结构强度。这一突破性材料有望应用于航空航天、高超音速飞行器及核反应堆领域。
items.whyImportant: 该材料技术的进步将显著提升极端环境下工业与国防装备的性能。

items.title: 中国 东盟外长关于应对中东局势演变对本地区影响及加强区域能源合作的联合声明
items.titleZh: 中国-东盟外长关于应对中东局势演变对本地区影响及加强区域能源合作的联合声明
items.summaryZh: 中国与东盟外长发表联合声明，就中东局势对区域的影响交换意见，并强调加强区域能源合作的重要性。双方致力于共同维护地区稳定与能源安全。
items.whyImportant: 该声明体现了中国与东盟在应对外部地缘政治冲击方面的协调与合作意愿。

items.title: 王赫 ： 从Kimi K3谈中美AI竞争之白热化
items.titleZh: 王赫：从Kimi K3谈中美AI竞争之白热化
items.summaryZh: 文章探讨了以Kimi K3为代表的AI技术发展，分析了中美两国在人工智能领域日益激烈的竞争态势。作者认为技术迭代速度已成为衡量国家竞争力的关键指标。
items.whyImportant: 人工智能领域的竞争已成为中美科技博弈的核心焦点。

items.title: What is a supernode, and why does it matter for the China-US tech rivalry?
items.summary: As the size of artificial intelligence models expands beyond 1 trillion parameters, a new concept is dominating the computing landscape: “supernode”. At this year’s World Artificial Intelligence Conference (WAIC), China’s top AI summit, domestic chipmakers from Huawei Technologies to Biren Technology showcased new hardware designed to knit hundreds or thousands of chips together to act as one giant supercomputer, which they called a supernode. The focus on supernodes at WAIC reflected a shift in...
items.titleZh: 什么是“超级节点”，它为何对中美科技竞争至关重要？
items.summaryZh: 随着AI模型参数规模突破万亿，中国芯片制造商正致力于开发“超级节点”技术，将成百上千个芯片连接成一个巨型超级计算机。这一概念已成为衡量AI算力竞争的新标准。
items.whyImportant: 算力基础设施的创新直接决定了AI大模型研发的上限与国家科技竞争力。

items.title: Japan courts India, Malaysia to escape US-China AI duopoly
items.summary: Japan has been establishing dialogue frameworks for artificial intelligence with like-minded countries and Global South partners to reduce reliance on top US and Chinese firms and promote domestic companies abroad. The outreach signals a growing recognition among those countries of the need for cooperation, rather than going it alone, to survive in the increasingly competitive field of AI. At home, Japan is seeking to foster its own domestic AI ecosystem. The move by the United States to...
items.titleZh: 日本拉拢印度、马来西亚，试图摆脱美中AI双头垄断
items.summaryZh: 日本正通过建立AI对话框架，加强与印度、马来西亚等全球南方国家的合作，以减少对美中科技巨头的依赖。此举旨在扶持日本本土AI生态系统并提升国际竞争力。
items.whyImportant: 日本的策略反映了中等强国在美中科技竞争夹缝中寻求自主权的努力。

items.title: 同样是海上执法 ， 美国用炮弹 ， 中国用水炮 ， CNN却说中国 欺负人 ？ |领海|黄岩岛|中国海警
items.titleZh: 同样是海上执法，美国用炮弹，中国用水炮，CNN却说中国欺负人？
items.summaryZh: 文章对比了中美在海上执法手段上的差异，并对西方媒体在报道中国海警执法时的双重标准提出了质疑。作者认为相关报道存在偏见。
items.whyImportant: 该评论反映了中国舆论对西方媒体在南海问题报道立场的不满。

items.title: Pizza, pasta, potatoes, protein - how Italian children became so overweight
items.summary: The Mediterranean diet was a blueprint for healthy living, yet Italian children are among the most overweight in Europe according to WHO.
items.titleZh: 披萨、意面、土豆、蛋白质——意大利儿童为何如此超重
items.summaryZh: 尽管地中海饮食常被视为健康饮食的典范，但世界卫生组织数据显示，意大利儿童的超重率在欧洲名列前茅。饮食习惯的改变被认为是导致这一现象的主要原因。
items.whyImportant: 这一现象揭示了传统饮食文化在现代生活方式冲击下面临的健康挑战。

items.title: Serbia's LGBTQ+ community faces 'epidemic of violence'
items.summary: Documented cases of violence against LGBTQ+ people in Serbia have never been higher. The attacks are part of a larger shift in society targeting marginalized people.
items.titleZh: 塞尔维亚LGBTQ+群体面临“暴力流行病”
items.summaryZh: 塞尔维亚针对LGBTQ+群体的暴力事件记录达到历史新高。这些攻击被视为社会对边缘群体排斥加剧的缩影。
items.whyImportant: 该问题凸显了塞尔维亚社会在人权保障与社会包容性方面面临的严峻挑战。

items.title: ドジャース 山本由伸 日米通算100勝に到達
items.summary: 大リーグ、ドジャースの山本由伸投手がメッツ戦に先発登板し、6回を1失点に抑えて、今シーズン11勝目をあげました。大リーグ通算30勝目で、プロ野球のオリックス時代にあげた70勝と合わせて日米通算100勝に到達です。
items.titleZh: 道奇队山本由伸达成日美职业生涯合计100胜
items.summaryZh: 效力于美国职棒大联盟道奇队的投手山本由伸在对阵大都会队的比赛中先发登板，取得本赛季第11胜。此役过后，他达成了日美职业生涯合计100胜的里程碑。
items.whyImportant: 这一成就标志着日本棒球运动员在国际顶级赛事中的持续影响力。
